```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Computes the **univariable Cox proportional hazards ratios** reported in the
text for Figures 1D–F and 2A–D (PPI vs no PPI). Does not write a figure file.

Clinical variables used: `days`, `vitalstatus`, `ppi`, `line_of_therapy`,
`prior_chemo`, `chemo_greater_one_year`.

Cleaned Cohort 1 object: `../data/cohort1-cleaned-clinical.RDS`

```{r libraries}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r load}
CoRR <- readRDS("../data/cohort1-cleaned-clinical.RDS") %>%
  select(days, vitalstatus, ppi, line_of_therapy, prior_chemo, chemo_greater_one_year)
```

```{r cox-models}
all_cancers <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi, data = CoRR)
first_line <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi, data = CoRR[CoRR$line_of_therapy == 1, ])
second_line <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi, data = CoRR[CoRR$line_of_therapy != 1, ])
wo_chemo <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi, data = CoRR[CoRR$prior_chemo == "no", ])
chemo <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi, data = CoRR[CoRR$prior_chemo == "yes", ])
more <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi, data = CoRR[CoRR$chemo_greater_one_year == 1, ])
less <- coxph(Surv(days, vitalstatus) ~ ppi, data = CoRR[CoRR$chemo_greater_one_year == 0, ])
```

```{r summarize}
models <- list(
  "All Cancers" = all_cancers,
  "1st Line" = first_line,
  "2nd Line+" = second_line,
  "No Chemo" = wo_chemo,
  "Prior Chemo" = chemo,
  ">1 Year Chemo" = more,
  "<=1 Year Chemo" = less
)

extract_cox_results <- function(model) {
  s <- summary(model)
  HR <- exp(s$coef[1])
  CI <- exp(confint(model))[1, ]
  pval <- s$coef[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  data.frame(
    HR = round(HR, 2),
    CI_lower = round(CI[1], 2),
    CI_upper = round(CI[2], 2),
    p_value = signif(pval, 3)
  )
}

cox_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models, extract_cox_results))
cox_results$Group <- names(models)
rownames(cox_results) <- NULL
cox_results <- cox_results[, c("Group", "HR", "CI_lower", "CI_upper", "p_value")]
print(cox_results)
```
